## Full-derivation equation slide

Starting from the definition, we expand step by step:

$$
\begin{aligned}
H_t &= H_0\left(1 - \frac{1}{2N}\right)^{t} \\
    &\approx H_0\, e^{-t/(2N)} \qquad \text{(for large } N\text{).}
\end{aligned}
$$

::: {.callout-note}
## Key result
Heterozygosity decays geometrically at rate $1/2N$ per generation.
:::


## Equation revealed in fragments

Setup line is always visible.

$$ p = \frac{2N_{11} + N_{12}}{2N} $$ {.fragment}

$$ q = 1 - p $$ {.fragment}
